question: With respect to sports, WADA stands for ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Anti-Doping Agency.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** World Anti-Doping Agency:-**

 
 
• **WADA is an international independent organization composed and funded equally by the sport movement and governments of the world. **
 
• It was established in 1999 to promote and coordinate the fight against doping in sport internationally.
 
• WADA's key activities include:
 
 
• **Scientific research**
 
• **Education**
 
• **Development of anti-doping capacities**
 
• **Monitoring of the World Anti-Doping Code (Code) - the document harmonizing anti-doping policies in all sports and all countries**
 
 
 
• WADA also maintains the Prohibited List, which is a list of substances and methods that are prohibited in sport. The Prohibited List is updated annually to reflect the latest scientific and medical knowledge.
